dnsPolicy.description:
DNS policy. Empty picks the role default (ClusterFirstWithHostNet when
the edge is enabled, ClusterFirst otherwise).
dnsPolicy.title: dnsPolicy

bindAddress.description:
Bind address for the public TLS and plain-HTTP listeners.
"[::]" is dual-stack: serves both IPv4 + IPv6.
bindAddress.title: bindAddress

dataDir.description: Data directory backed by an emptyDir volume (TOWONEL_DATA_DIR).
dataDir.title: dataDir

enabled.description:
Run the public edge (TOWONEL_EDGE_ENABLED). Switches the workload to a
hostNetwork DaemonSet; pin it to the right nodes with nodeSelector/affinity.
enabled.title: enabled

healthBindAddress.description: Bind address for the edge health/metrics listener.
healthBindAddress.title: healthBindAddress

httpPort.description: Plain HTTP port for ACME HTTP-01 and redirects (TOWONEL_EDGE_HTTP_LISTEN_ADDR).
httpPort.title: httpPort

metricsPort.description: Port serving edge health and Prometheus metrics (TOWONEL_EDGE_HEALTH_LISTEN_ADDR).
metricsPort.title: metricsPort

env.description:
Extra environment variables passed to the container (k8s EnvVar list).
Deployment-specific configuration (DB DSN, public URLs, region, OTEL) goes here.
env.title: env

envFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources (e.g. secrets created by ExternalSecret).
envFrom.title: envFrom

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

hub.description:
Default values for towonel-node — the towonel hub/edge node.

One towonel-node process can run the hub control plane, the public edge,
or both (hub.enabled / edge.enabled) — both by default, the single-node
topology. The chart derives the workload kind, networking, listeners,
probes and resource defaults from the enabled roles: hub-only renders a
Deployment; an enabled edge renders a hostNetwork DaemonSet that binds
the public 443/80 listeners directly on each node.

apiPort.description: Port the user/operator HTTP API listens on (TOWONEL_HUB_LISTEN_ADDR).
apiPort.title: apiPort

linkPort.description: Port edges dial for the hub link (TOWONEL_HUB_LINK_LISTEN_ADDR).
linkPort.title: linkPort

metricsPort.description: Port serving hub health and Prometheus metrics (TOWONEL_HUB_HEALTH_LISTEN_ADDR).
metricsPort.title: metricsPort

hub.title: hub

digest.description:
Pin the image by digest (sha256:...); when set, overrides the tag.
The release pipeline fills it with the published image's digest.
digest.title: digest

tag.description: Overrides the image tag; defaults to the chart appVersion.
tag.title: tag

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.
imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe. Empty picks the role default (see startupProbe).
livenessProbe.title: livenessProbe

annotations.description: Annotations added to the dashboard ConfigMap.
annotations.title: annotations

enabled.description:
Render the Grafana dashboard ConfigMap (for grafana-operator or the
kube-prometheus-stack sidecar). The dashboard covers hub and edge metrics.
enabled.title: enabled

allowCrossNamespaceImport.description: If true allows for a Grafana in any namespace to access this GrafanaDashboard.
allowCrossNamespaceImport.title: allowCrossNamespaceImport

enabled.description: Render a GrafanaDashboard CR (grafana-operator) instead of a sidecar ConfigMap.
enabled.title: enabled

folder.description: Folder to create the dashboard in.
folder.title: folder

matchLabels.description: Selector labels for the Grafana instance. Must be set when enabled.
matchLabels.title: matchLabels

resyncPeriod.description: Resync period for the Grafana operator to check for updates to the dashboard.
resyncPeriod.title: resyncPeriod

labels.description: Labels added to the dashboard ConfigMap.
labels.title: labels

namespace.description: Namespace for the dashboard objects; defaults to the release namespace.
namespace.title: namespace

additionalRuleLabels.description: Extra labels added to every alert rule (e.g. cluster).
additionalRuleLabels.title: additionalRuleLabels

enabled.description:
Create a PrometheusRule with the hub alerting rules
(rendered only when the hub is enabled).
enabled.title: enabled

enabled.description:
Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor with an endpoint per
enabled role (requires its CRDs).
enabled.title: enabled

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.
nameOverride.title: nameOverride

podSecurityContext.description:
Pod-level securityContext. Empty picks the role default: non-root
uid/gid 10001 for hub-only; unset when the edge is enabled (it must run
as root to bind the privileged host ports).
podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext

readinessProbe.description:
Readiness probe. Empty picks the role default (/health on edge-metrics
when the edge is enabled, /v1/readyz on hub-api otherwise).
readinessProbe.title: readinessProbe

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas (Deployment only; only one hub replica is the active leader).
replicaCount.title: replicaCount

resources.description:
Pod resource requests/limits. Empty picks the role default:
500m/256Mi requests + 2Gi limit when the edge is enabled,
100m/256Mi requests + 512Mi limit otherwise.
resources.title: resources

securityContext.description:
Container securityContext (read-only root filesystem, drops ALL
capabilities, keeps NET_BIND_SERVICE for the edge's privileged listeners).
securityContext.title: securityContext

service.description: Service configuration. Ports follow the enabled roles' listener ports.

enabled.description: Create a Service for the enabled listeners.
enabled.title: enabled

service.title: service

automount.description: Automount the API token (off by default: the node does not talk to the cluster API).
automount.title: automount

name.description: ServiceAccount name; generated from the release name if empty.
name.title: name

startupProbe.description:
Startup probe. Empty picks the role default (/health on the edge-metrics
port when the edge is enabled, /v1/health on hub-api otherwise).
startupProbe.title: startupProbe

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period for in-flight connections on shutdown.
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: terminationGracePeriodSeconds

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts on the container.
volumeMounts.title: volumeMounts

volumes.description: Additional volumes on the workload (e.g. postgres client certificates).
volumes.title: volumes

annotations.description: Annotations added to the workload (e.g. reloader.stakater.com/auto).
annotations.title: annotations

kind.description:
Workload kind: Deployment or DaemonSet. Empty picks the role default
(DaemonSet when the edge is enabled, Deployment otherwise).
kind.title: kind
